notice.title: Legal notice
notice.metaTitle: Legal notice | L'Instant Tranquille, cottage in Sologne
notice.description: Who publishes and hosts the website of the L'Instant Tranquille cottage in Romorantin-Lanthenay: publisher, host, photo and map credits.
notice.lede: Who publishes this website, who hosts it and who owns its content.

publisher.title: Publisher
publisher.body:
This website is published by {hosts}, hosts of the L'Instant Tranquille cottage.

Address: {address}, {postalCode} {city}, France.

Contact: {email}

Publication director: {hosts}.

hosting.title: Hosting
hosting.body:
The website is hosted by Vercel Inc., 440 N Barranca Ave #4133, Covina, CA 91723, United States, vercel.com. The website's functions run in the Frankfurt region, in Germany.

The database is hosted by Neon. Photos and media files are stored on Vercel Blob.

The domain name, DNS, email reception and the anti-bot protection of the contact form (Turnstile) are provided by Cloudflare, Inc., 101 Townsend St, San Francisco, CA 94107, United States.

booking.title: Booking
booking.body:
The cottage is booked on Airbnb and Booking. These platforms apply their own terms and their own privacy policies.

This website does not collect any payment.

property.title: Intellectual property and credits
property.body:
The texts and the photos of the cottage belong to {hosts}. Please ask for their consent before reusing them.

The photos of nearby places are credited one by one, with their licence, next to each image.

Maps are provided by OpenStreetMap and its contributors. Drive times are calculated with OSRM.

data.title: Personal data
data.body: The website only gathers the information you send through the contact form. The details are in the privacy policy.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.metaTitle: Privacy policy | L'Instant Tranquille, cottage in Sologne
privacy.description: The data gathered by the L'Instant Tranquille cottage website: the contact form, no audience measurement, no advertising, and your rights.
privacy.lede: What the website gathers when you write to us, what it is used for and how to exercise your rights.

controller.title: Data controller
controller.body:
The data controllers are {hosts}, hosts of the L'Instant Tranquille cottage, {address}, {postalCode} {city}, France.

Contact: {email}

collected.title: Data collected
collected.body:
The website only collects the data you enter in the contact form:

  • your name;
  • your email address;
  • your phone number, if you give it;
  • your preferred dates, if you state them;
  • your message.

The website does not ask you to create an account.

purpose.title: Purpose and legal basis
purpose.body:
This data is used only to answer your request.

This processing is based on pre-contractual steps taken at your request and on our legitimate interest in answering you.

recipients.title: Recipients
recipients.body:
Your messages are read by {hosts}.

They pass through the website's technical providers:

  • Vercel, for hosting the website and its media files;
  • Neon, for the database where your message is saved;
  • Cloudflare, for the domain name, email reception and the anti-bot protection of the form (Turnstile).

retention.title: Retention period
retention.body:
Your data is kept for the time needed to handle your request and, where applicable, the stay that follows from it.

It is deleted on request to {email}.

transfers.title: Transfers outside the European Union
transfers.body: Vercel, Neon and Cloudflare are American providers. Your data may therefore be processed outside the European Union. These transfers are governed by the contractual commitments of these providers.

cookies.title: Cookies and trackers
cookies.body:
This website uses no audience measurement tool and no advertising, and sets no cookie of its own during your visit.

It only stores, in your browser:

  • the fact that the opening screen has already been played, for the duration of your visit;
  • your choice to turn the sound of that screen on or off.

When you start filling in the contact form, Cloudflare's Turnstile anti-bot protection loads. It may store technical items needed for the check.

Map backgrounds are loaded by your browser from OpenStreetMap's servers.

The administration area, reserved for the hosts, uses a login cookie. It does not concern visitors.

booking.title: Booking on Airbnb and Booking
booking.body: Booking is done on Airbnb and Booking, which apply their own terms and their own privacy policies. This website does not collect any payment.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body:
You can ask for access to your data, its rectification, its erasure, the restriction of its processing or its portability, and you can object to its processing.

To do so, write to {email}.

You can also lodge a complaint with the CNIL, the French data protection authority, at cnil.fr.
